source.citation: Wijeratne, Pattiaratchi and Proctor (2018), Estimates of Surface and Subsurface Boundary Current Transport Around Australia, JGR Oceans 123, 3444–3466.
reviewed_locators: Section 4, WAC discussion and summary item 6
source.access: Publisher full HTML passages read; retained original PDF pages 11 and 16 (printed 3454 and 3459), Figures 6 and 10, rendered and visually inspected. No figure digitization or original field processing.

original_visual_review.figure_6: Author labels the circulation drawing as schematic. Arrow trajectories are not diagnosed current centerlines and cannot supply a ranked length.
original_visual_review.figure_10: Panels a and b show cumulative transport in Sv, not velocity or current-edge contours. Panel d distinguishes upper-300-m black curves from full-depth red curves. Contours must not be traced as current axes or width boundaries.
original_visual_review.source_label_conflict: Section 3.2.3 prose calls x1 22S; Figure 10d labels x1 22.5S. Neither is repaired or promoted to a physical endpoint.

support.quantity_time_support: Long-term model mean; not a dated observation or seasonal current geometry.

pathway.source_identification_strength: Author identifies modeled recirculation as part of WAC; discussion retains tentative wording about its location.
pathway.relation: Recirculation between southern and central SICC branches; offshore turn south of the central branch.

section_context.quantity: Net northward transport interval in cumulative model section
section_context.interpretation: A section of the modeled recirculation; not a thresholded current-core width or a whole-current footprint.

section_context.quantity: Net northward transport interval in cumulative model section
section_context.interpretation: Regional circulation context. Source discusses both Flinders/sSICC supply and sSICC offshore recirculation; this interval is not independently assigned as a WAC core.

reported_transport_context.statistic: Approximate model mean transport context; not an independent new current measurement admission.

effect_on_remaining_gap.next_action: Figures 6 and 10 support pathway context but do not provide a digitizable velocity axis. Establish a source-consistent northward-to-offshore flow corridor and separate it from Flinders supply, Leeuwin flow and eddy recirculation before proposing any axis or new gates. Seek velocity-based boundary/axis support; do not infer endpoints from SICC inflow maxima.
